intro: Partsong helps you learn your part of a choir piece. Here's how.
add: Take photos of your music, or open a PDF. We'll use the sample score.
pages: Check your pages are in order, then tap Read music.
systems: The red lines show where each line of music ends. They're usually right. If one isn't, tap between the staves to fix it.
reading: Then Partsong reads the notes. That can take a minute or two.
pick: Open the settings, and choose the part you sing.
others: Turn the other parts down, so your line stands out.
tempo: And slow it down while you learn.
follow: The score follows along as it plays. Tap any bar to start from there.
share: When you're ready, send a link to the rest of the choir. They get the score, with your settings.
end: Partsong. Free on your iPhone, Android and desktop. No account needed.
